transcript_segments.text: please remain calm i have reviewed the situation and after careful consideration i have decided
i am probably the situation which is inconvenient i used to think if i could name every wire
i could stop the whole house from catching fire label the switches diagram the sparks
put little warning signs over the difficult parts this one controls the childhood this
one makes jokes when afraid this one says i'm fine so convincingly even i file it away
someone said you don't have to explain yourself which is sweet also suspicious
because i have met myself and frankly context helps there are doors in me that open sideways
there are stairs that forget what height is there are rooms where the light switch works
but only if no one asked why it's like this and yes i know that sounds dramatic
but so is pretending a locked basement is just storage because the listing said
open plan maybe i made the map too large maybe i named too many roads
maybe i turned every star into something with a code i'm looking for the manual override
something in me still alive past the warning lights past the reasons i provide i'm more
than the fault i find more than the wires i hide behind if you stay beside the noise
you might hear my actual voice it's under settings obviously nested for no reason
i used to rehearse being human like there'd be a practical exam smile here pause there
ask about their weekend do not mention mortality before the second drink i learned eye contact
like a hostage negotiation too little suspicious too much cult leader somewhere in the middle
there is a currently friendship i make plans with the version of me who believes in calendars
then actual me arrives wearing yesterday's weather and holding one shoe for reasons still under
investigation and people say just tell me what you need as if need is a clean little package
with a bow and a tracking number sometimes need is fog sometimes need is a chance sometimes need
is leaving the room before my face starts making statements my mouth cannot legally defend
sometimes i don't know until the damage is sent to receipt but i am trying badly with paperwork
i'm looking for the manual override something in me still alive past the warning lights
past the reasons i provide i'm more than the fault i find more than the wires i hide behind
if you stay beside the noise you might hear my actual voice i get tired of being both the fire
and the evacuation plan of saying sorry for the smoke while still coughing from the room that
made it i know i can be shocked i have watched my words leave my mouth wearing boots i have seen
kindness come out crooked because it had to pass through old machinery but listen not every
alarm is manipulation not every shutdown is refusal not every silence is punishment
sometimes the system is not ignoring you sometimes it is using everything it has not to
disappear so here is the part where i stop pretending self knowledge is the same thing
as self trust because i know the patterns i know the loops i know the exits i choose
then the cues of being proof i can aim the weather that doesn't mean i have to become a
forecast forever maybe the override was never been lever behind glass maybe it was smaller
a breath before the joke a text before the vanishing a hand on the table instead of a
case for the defense maybe i say i'm overwhelmed before i turn into fate or maybe you say
take your time but i'm making time sound like a loan there's a place between full disclosure
and closed doors between here is every room and nothing to see here i'm trying to stand there
not perfectly not politely but present i'm looking for the manual override
something in me is still alive past the warning lights that's the reasons i provide i'm more
than the fault i find more than the wires i hide behind if you stay beside the noise
you might hear my actual voice i'm looking for the manual override and not to erase what i
survived just to choose the door this time before the old alarms decide so i may require patience
i may arrive strangely i may need to restart the sentence several times but i'm not a broken machine
i am a person learning which buttons were never meant to be pressed and which ones were mine
